title: UI & Visual Designer Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to move from zero to a job‑ready portfolio, covering visual fundamentals, core tools, real projects, and professional readiness. Each phase builds concrete skills and tangible outputs you can showcase.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Learn the visual language and basic design principles.

milestones.title: Typography Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can choose appropriate typefaces, set hierarchy, and apply spacing consistently.

tasks.title: Read MDN Typography guide
tasks.description: Study the basics of type anatomy, classification, and web font loading on MDN.

tasks.title: Identify type hierarchy in 3 websites
tasks.description: Pick three sites and note headings, body text, and UI labels, describing their hierarchy.

tasks.title: Create a typographic scale in Figma
tasks.description: Build a 5‑step scale using a chosen font and document size, line‑height, and weight choices.

tasks.title: Reflect on readability choices
tasks.description: Write a short note on why you selected each size and weight for clarity.

milestones.title: Colour & Layout Basics
milestones.outcome: Can construct balanced layouts and apply effective colour palettes.

tasks.title: Study colour theory on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Complete the colour theory module covering hue, saturation, and contrast.

tasks.title: Extract colour palettes from 5 apps
tasks.description: Use a colour picker to record primary, secondary, and accent colours, noting their purpose.

tasks.title: Design a 8‑grid layout in Figma
tasks.description: Set up an 8‑column grid and place placeholder elements to practice spacing.

tasks.title: Apply a palette to the grid design
tasks.description: Assign the extracted palette to UI elements, ensuring contrast meets accessibility standards.

tasks.title: Connect with a design community thread
tasks.description: Share your grid and palette on a Reddit design subreddit for feedback.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Master industry‑standard tools and systematic design approaches.

milestones.title: Figma Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can prototype screens, use components, and collaborate in Figma.

tasks.title: Complete Figma Basics on YouTube
tasks.description: Watch the official Figma tutorial covering frames, layers, and components.

tasks.title: Build a component library
tasks.description: Create buttons, inputs, and cards as reusable components with variants.

tasks.title: Prototype a login flow
tasks.description: Link screens with interactions, add simple overlays, and test the flow.

tasks.title: Share prototype for feedback
tasks.description: Generate a share link and post it to a design forum for critique.

tasks.title: Reflect on component reuse
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how components saved time and ensured consistency.

milestones.title: Design Systems Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can define and document a cohesive design system.

tasks.title: Read Material Design guidelines
tasks.description: Explore the official Material Design documentation on tokens and components.

tasks.title: Create a style guide in Figma
tasks.description: Document typography, colour, spacing, and elevation tokens in a single file.

tasks.title: Develop a component variant set
tasks.description: Add size and state variants to a button component and document usage rules.

tasks.title: Connect with a design system community
tasks.description: Join a Discord channel focused on design systems and introduce your guide.

tasks.title: Reflect on system consistency
tasks.description: Note three ways the system improves UI consistency and developer handoff.

milestones.title: Prototyping & Motion
milestones.outcome: Can create interactive prototypes with basic motion effects.

tasks.title: Watch Figma Motion tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official Figma motion tutorial covering smart animate and easing.

tasks.title: Add micro‑interactions to a button
tasks.description: Create hover and press states with subtle scaling and colour shifts.

tasks.title: Prototype a swipe transition
tasks.description: Link two screens with a swipe left animation using smart animate.

tasks.title: Share motion prototype for critique
tasks.description: Export a video of the interaction and post it on a design forum for feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on motion impact
tasks.description: Write a short note on how motion improves user perception of speed.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply learned skills to create portfolio‑ready projects.

milestones.title: Design System Project
milestones.outcome: A complete, documented design system you can showcase.

tasks.title: Define project scope
tasks.description: Outline the components, tokens, and documentation pages for a small system.

tasks.title: Build component library
tasks.description: Create at least 8 components with variants in Figma.

tasks.title: Write usage guidelines
tasks.description: Document component purpose, states, and accessibility notes.

tasks.title: Export assets for handoff
tasks.description: Generate SVGs and style tokens ready for developers.

tasks.title: Add project to portfolio site
tasks.description: Upload screenshots, description, and a link to the Figma file.

milestones.title: Polished App Screens
milestones.outcome: Three high‑fidelity app screens demonstrating visual and interaction design.

tasks.title: Sketch screen concepts on paper
tasks.description: Sketch three distinct app screens focusing on layout and hierarchy.

tasks.title: Design screens in Figma
tasks.description: Create high‑fidelity versions using your typography and colour system.

tasks.title: Add interactive prototypes
tasks.description: Link screens with transitions and micro‑interactions.

tasks.title: Gather peer feedback
tasks.description: Share the prototype with peers and collect actionable comments.

tasks.title: Iterate based on feedback
tasks.description: Refine visual details and interaction timing per feedback.

milestones.title: Motion Prototype
milestones.outcome: A short motion prototype showcasing an interaction with fluid animation.

tasks.title: Select an interaction to animate
tasks.description: Choose a common UI pattern like a modal opening or toggle switch.

tasks.title: Create motion frames in Figma
tasks.description: Design start and end states and set smart animate properties.

tasks.title: Export animation as video
tasks.description: Record the prototype playback and export a GIF or MP4.

tasks.title: Post on portfolio with description
tasks.description: Add the animation to your portfolio with a brief case study.

tasks.title: Reflect on motion choices
tasks.description: Write a note on easing, timing, and user perception decisions.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish your portfolio, master handoff, and prepare for job or client interviews.

milestones.title: Handoff to Engineers
milestones.outcome: Can deliver design specs and assets that developers can implement directly.

tasks.title: Study Figma Inspect features
tasks.description: Read the official Figma help article on Inspect and CSS export.

tasks.title: Create a handoff spec page
tasks.description: Document layout, spacing, colour, and typography for a screen using Figma’s specs.

tasks.title: Export assets in required formats
tasks.description: Generate PNG, SVG, and PDF assets with proper naming conventions.

tasks.title: Mock a developer review meeting
tasks.description: Present the spec to a peer acting as a developer and answer questions.

tasks.title: Reflect on handoff clarity
tasks.description: Note three improvements to make specs more developer‑friendly.

milestones.title: Portfolio & Personal Brand
milestones.outcome: A polished online portfolio and clear personal narrative ready for recruiters.

tasks.title: Choose a portfolio platform
tasks.description: Select a free site like Behance or a simple GitHub Pages template.

tasks.title: Write case studies for each project
tasks.description: Describe problem, process, role, and outcome in 200‑300 words per project.

tasks.title: Add high‑quality visuals
tasks.description: Export screens and motion clips at 2x resolution and embed them.

tasks.title: Create a concise designer bio
tasks.description: Write a 3‑sentence bio highlighting strengths and tools.

tasks.title: Connect with recruiters on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Send personalized connection requests mentioning your portfolio.

milestones.title: Interview Preparation
milestones.outcome: Confidently discuss design decisions and showcase work in interviews.

tasks.title: Review common UI design interview questions
tasks.description: Read a free blog post listing typical design interview prompts.

tasks.title: Prepare a design story deck
tasks.description: Create 5 slides summarizing a project, focusing on typography choices and outcomes.

tasks.title: Conduct a mock interview
tasks.description: Practice answering questions with a friend or mentor and record feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback and improve
tasks.description: Note two areas to strengthen in future interviews.

tasks.title: Connect with a design mentor
tasks.description: Reach out to a senior designer for a brief portfolio review session.
